versions.content: For BswMSwitchAckNotification , if the referenced BswM- SwitchPort is configured with BswMModeSwitchInterfaceRef without a BswM- SchMModeDeclarationGroupRef : This specifies a ModeSwitchedAckEvent, which the BswM shall create in its SWCD. The BswM shall create an associated runnable; the C definition of this runnable/schedulable entity shall arbitrate the ModeSwitchedAck- Event.
